name: claude-skills
description: Clint's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Playwright testing, human-in-the-loop demo/verification workflow, Claude Code environment setup (token optimization, status line), and Godot 4 C# project setup

plugins.name: game-catchup
plugins.description: Generate a structured 'what you missed' recap for a game you haven't played in a while

plugins.name: feature-maturity
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary for how done a feature is: a Completeness ladder (Spike/Prototype/Functional/Finished) plus independent quality axes (Polish, Robustness, Architecture, Verification, Documentation, Accessibility)

plugins.name: desktop-statusline
plugins.description: Shows the terminal status line (model, session tokens, context %, 5h/7d rate limits) as a band above the prompt in the Claude desktop app

plugins.name: subagent-tree
plugins.description: Side pane showing subagents as a tree with last-tool activity, tokens and runtime per agent, click-through detail, search, and saved history of past sessions
